name: Tamiyo, Compleated Sage
oracle_text:
Compleated ({G/U/P} can be paid with {G}, {U}, or 2 life. If life was paid, this planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.)
+1: Tap up to one target artifact or creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
−X: Exile target nonland permanent card with mana value X from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of that card.
−7: Create Tamiyo's Notebook, a legendary colorless Book artifact token with "Spells you cast cost {2} less to cast" and "{T}: Draw a card."

needs.what: The Compleated keyword: when a Phyrexian hybrid symbol {G/U/P} in the planeswalker's cost is paid with 2 life, it enters with two fewer loyalty counters per such symbol paid with life
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The keyword list has no compleated, and no card-level cost key or condition reads whether Phyrexian mana was paid with life to reduce starting loyalty; `loyalty` is a fixed integer on the card

needs.what: A −X loyalty cost where X is chosen on activation and the effects read X (here: target nonland permanent card in your graveyard with mana value X, then create a token copy of that exiled card)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost.loyalty takes only fixed signed integers; x_value exists as a cost key but nothing ties it to removing X loyalty counters, and creating a token copy of a card (not a permanent) from exile is not an established copy_permanent usage
